items.title_en: Top 10 Self-Made Women in India 2026: Jayshree Ullal retains her No. 1 position
items.title_zh: 2026 年印度十大白手起家女性：Jayshree Ullal 保持第一名的位置
items.summary_en: Top 10 Self-Made Women in the M3M Hurun India Rich List 2026:From tech titan Jayshree Ullal claiming the top spot to beauty and pharma pioneers, the 2026 M3M Hurun India Rich List spotlights the 10 self-made women redefining wealth creation in India.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 M3M 胡润印度富豪榜十大白手起家女性：从夺得榜首的科技巨头 Jayshree Ullal 到美容和制药领域的先驱，2026 年 M3M 胡润印度富豪榜重点关注了 10 位重新定义印度财富创造的白手起家女性。

items.title_en: Monkey enters Ranchi wine shop, drinks liquor and falls asleep: WATCH
items.title_zh: 猴子进入兰契酒店，喝了酒就睡着了：观看
items.summary_en: A man filming the incident can be heard claiming that the monkey is pregnant. He then points towards an empty liquor bottle and says that the monkey consumed all of it.
items.summary_zh: 一名拍摄这一事件的男子声称猴子怀孕了。然后他指着一个空酒瓶说猴子把它喝光了。

items.title_en: Harsh Goenka shares Vande Bharat video with littered seats: ‘How to teach civic sense?’
items.title_zh: 严酷的葛恩卡 (Harsh Goenka) 与乱七八糟的座位分享了范德·巴拉特 (Vande Bharat) 视频：“如何教授公民意识？”
items.summary_en: The video, shared by Harsh Goenka on X, offered a before-and-after look at the passenger experience.
items.summary_zh: 该视频由 Harsh Goenka 在 X 上分享，展示了乘客体验前后的对比。

items.title_en: PM Modi joins ‘Bhajan Clubbing’ event in Delhi, claps and plays tambourine
items.title_zh: 莫迪总理参加在德里举行的“Bhajan Clubbing”活动，击掌并打手鼓
items.summary_en: The event was held at Deen Dayal Upadhyay Park to mark the 110th birth anniversary of Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya, one of the key leaders of the Bharatiya Jana Sangh.
items.summary_zh: 该活动在 Deen Dayal Upadhyay 公园举行，旨在纪念印度人民党 (Bharatiya Jana Sangh) 的主要领导人之一潘迪特·迪恩达亚尔·乌帕迪亚 (Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya) 诞辰 110 周年。
